svg.title: SpiralCore ternary tree and orbit
svg.desc: Left: a complete three-branch tree of depth four, laid out radially, with nodes numbered in breadth-first order (depth 1 holds 1 to 3, depth 4 holds 40 to 120) and one root-to-leaf path highlighted. Right: the 16 roots of the E8 orbit of (2,2,0,0,0,0,0,0) joined by the 15 edges of the anchor's breadth-first transport tree; each edge is one generator, a signed permutation of the eight coordinates. The path from the anchor to the root that the highlighted ports select is highlighted, with its generators named. Orbit data come from the tables the discrete crate's build script generates.
svg.text: SpiralCore: a ternary tree picks a block, the orbit moves it
Left: one choice of three per level. Right: the chosen block travels along exact edges between the 16 roots of an E8 orbit.
nodes numbered in breadth-first order; one path highlighted
The left path's ports 1, 0, 2, 1 select root 1
